title: ds-bridge history record v2 (one line of .ds-bridge/history.jsonl)
description: One v2 history line (SPEC-history-v2 §2): the envelope keys, then the kind's payload keys verbatim. A line without `v` is v1 (not covered). The payload is open by design (each kind has its own fields); `history export` flattens it to rows.
